## Repository rules (content PRs)

- [ ] I edited **source data** under `_data/` (or `_data/companies/`) — **not** generated `docs/*.md` or `README.md` alone
- [ ] I ran **`just readme`** and/or **`just generate`** when outputs should change (or noted in the PR that maintainers should regenerate)
- [ ] Regenerated `docs/*.md` / `README.md` are included in this PR if I ran the generators locally

See **[contributing.md](../contributing.md#repository-rules-read-this-first)**.
